scope: Read-only scientific probe. P1 descriptively decomposes the registered point-error risk of four frozen fit297 prediction sets and reproduces published risk/RMSE/denominator gates; P2 reports conditioning and prior sensitivity of the frozen initial hidden force system. No training, no model selection, no mechanism or identifiability claim.

p2.interpretation_scope: Conditioning and prior sensitivity of the registered ridge least-squares operator only: singular spectrum, condition number, effective rank, ridge contribution and a diagnostic ridge scan. This is not a data-identifiability claim under a noise model, and no model/mechanism conclusion is made.

boundaries: P1 reproduces published risks, pooled RMSE, denominators and the four-term identity at the stated tolerances; it is descriptive and does not discriminate mechanisms.
P2 reports conditioning and prior sensitivity of the frozen initializer; the ridge scan and r0 model-dependence comparison are diagnostics, not data-identifiability results.
P2b (ridge to 8 s risk) was not run; no downstream-risk claim is made.
No val/test payload is read, no optimizer is created and no model is trained or selected.
No mechanism, optimization-sufficiency or model-adoption conclusion is asserted.
